scope: Dino runtime/UI, targeted tests, handoff and the existing read-only spatial workflow only. No new PR, branch, staging/transfer workflow, private hub or sibling changes.
observedDefects: The spatial UI did not mirror ordinary toast/radio messages.
Tidegate full map updated only while its modal was open; neither game had a live spatial map.
Default aperture was about 0.565 m high at 2.4 m width.
Controller focus could move off the page currently rendered in XR.
changes: Two-second wall-clock floor notices and bounded recent-message history.
Persistent actual goal, interaction and control-profile guidance plus live map.
2 m default box height, independent menu/box/height sizing with display-center preservation.
Spatial page follows actual controller focus.
beforeEvidence: Three explicit baseline source/presentation assertions failed; these are not native playthroughs. Two intermediate failures were formatting-sensitive source tests and were corrected without changing the gameplay assertions.
limitations: Local HTTP navigation is blocked by policy. Hosted exact-source and public gameplay/byte checks remain distinct from model evidence. No actor, mission, reward or inventory assignment is used to manufacture browser acceptance.
remaining: Inspect hosted feedback/spatial captures and failures; verify Pages and public hashes and journeys before claiming the release is published.
